description.value: Kin's Farm Market is a family-founded, 100% Canadian-owned specialty produce retailer that grew from an 8-foot table at Granville Island Market in 1983 to 23 locations across the Lower Mainland. The Williams Road location in Richmond is part of a chain known for locally-grown BC fruits and vegetables alongside global produce. It is a practical fresh-food resupply stop for cyclists touring the Richmond area.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 23m; rack at 66m; rack at 74m; rack at 99m.
